title: A method to fix and permeabilize isolated adult mouse cardiomyocytes for immuno-staining and confocal imaging
protocol: Suspend isolated adult mouse ventricular myocytes in culture medium composed of 5% fetal bovine serum, 47.5% MEM, 47.5% modified Tyrode’s solution, 10 mM pyruvic acid, 4.0 mM HEPES, and 6.1 mM glucose.
Maintain the cells in a 5% CO2 atmosphere at 30 ºC until use.
Label the cells with MitoTracker Deep Red 633 for staining mitochondria (100 nm in the culture medium) and incubate for 30 min while at the CO2 incubator.
Wash the cells with PBS twice and resuspend in fresh PBS.
Pellet the isolated cardiomyocytes using low g force (300 g for 1 minute, 30 ºC).
Suspend the pelleted cells in 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS maintained at 30 ºC.
Fix the suspended cells for 30 minutes with gentle mixing by inverting the tube using a nutating mixer.
Pellet down the fixed cells (300 g for 1 minute) and resuspend them in PBS.
Layer the cells over chambered cover glass coated with Cell-Tak cell and tissue adhesive.
Leave the fixed cells layered over the chambered cover glass undisturbed for 2 hours at room temperature.
Wash the non-adherent cells using PBS after they settle to the glass surface.
Permeabilize the fixed cardiomyocytes adhered to the Cell Tak coated cover glass surface using 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS (v/v) for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Wash the permeabilized cells with PBS (2 times, each for 2 minutes).
Process the cells for immunostaining after washing.
Treat permeabilized cardiomyocytes with blocking solution containing 0.01% BSA in PBS for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Label fixed cells with Alexa Fluor 568 phalloidin for staining F-actin for 30 minutes at room temperature in the dark.
Stain nuclei with SYTO 11 Green-Fluorescent Nucleic Acid stain for 30 minutes at room temperature in the dark.
Wash cells with PBS (2 times, 2 minutes each).
Incubate a secondary antibody after washing if primary antibodies were used.
Wash cells again with PBS (3 times, 3 minutes each).
Maintain cells in PBS containing antibiotics.
Store chambers in dark at 4°C until imaging to avoid photo bleaching.
